recipes.name: Chocolate peppermint cakes
sentences: Preheat oven to 180°C/160°C fan-forced.
Line 15 holes of two 12-hole standard muffin pans with paper cases.
Drop ¼ cup of mixture into cases.
Bake about 20 minutes.
Stand 5 minutes; turn, top-side up, onto wire rack to cool.

recipes.name: Little Christmas cakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup (125g) chopped glacé fruit (such as pineapple, apricot, peach)
1 cup (220g) firmly packed dark brown sugar
1 teaspoon mixed spice red glacé cherries, to decorate
sentences: Combine all fruit in large bowl and stir in ½ cup of the brandy.
Preheat oven to 160°C/325°F.
Lightly grease 20 holes of two 12-hole (¹/³-cup/80ml) muffin pans.
Bake for about 30 minutes.
Stand cakes in pans for 5 minutes before turning, top-side up, onto wire rack to cool.

recipes.name: Poached pears with chocolate cream
ingredients: 200 gram dark eating chocolate, chopped coarsely
sentences: Bring to the boil; simmer, covered, about 8 minutes or until pears are just tender, drain.
Meanwhile, combine chocolate and cream in small saucepan; stir over low heat about 5 minutes or until smooth.

recipes.name: Brown rice and split pea salad with orange dressing
ingredients: 150 gram (4½ ounces) snow peas, sliced thinly
1 medium_piece (200g) red capsicum (bell pepper), chopped finely
80 gram (2½ ounces) baby spinach leaves, shredded coarsely
1/3 cup (80ml) strained freshly squeezed orange juice
sentences: Cook rice and split peas in medium saucepan of boiling water about 20 minutes or until tender.

recipes.name: Freekeh salad with roast pumpkin
ingredients: ¼ cup (60ml) extra virgin olive oil
1 large red onion (300g), cut into wedges
sentences: Cover, reduce heat to low; cook for 30 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 200°C (180°C fan-forced).
Reserve 1 teaspoon of the walnuts.
Drizzle with 2 tablespoons oil and remaining Lebanese Spice Mix; toss to coat.
Bake pumpkin for 40 minutes and capsicum and onion for 25 minutes or until vegetables are browned and tender.

recipes.name: Seafood and chicken tomato rice
ingredients: 600 gram chicken thigh fillets, chopped coarsely
1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
sentences: Reduce heat; simmer, covered, 25 minutes.
Return chicken and prawns to pan with clams; simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until rice is tender and clams open.

recipes.name: Tuna, bean and basil salad
ingredients: 420 gram can cannellini beans, rinsed, drained
sentences: In a large bowl, combine onion and vinegar; stand for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain tuna over small bowl; reserve 2 tablespoons of the oil.

recipes.name: Veal stroganoff with buttered sage pasta
ingredients: 250 gram ricciolini pasta (or other short pasta)

recipes.name: Vietnamese beef pho
ingredients: 1/3 cup loosely packed fresh mint leaves
1/4 cup loosely packed fresh coriander leaves
2 fresh long red chillies, thinly sliced
1 medium lemon, cut into six wedges
sentences: Reduce heat; simmer, covered, 30 minutes.
Uncover, simmer 30 minutes or until beef is tender.

recipes.name: Passionfruit skin jam
sentences: Reduce heat, simmer, covered, about 30 minutes or until the white flesh inside the passionfruit skins turns a burgundy colour and is soft enough to remove from the outer skin.
Measure flesh mixture, allow 1 cup of sugar for each cup of flesh mixture.
Boil uncovered, without stirring, about 40 minutes or until jam jells when tested.
Stand jam 10 minutes.
